newsitem.title: USA: John Alden may withdraw from some states.
newsitem.headline: John Alden may withdraw from some states.

text.p: John Alden Financial Corp said on Tuesday it planned to significantly limit its marketing efforts and exposure in certain U.S. states where it did not see market share and profitability opportunities.
It said it might also might withdraw its business from certain states.
John Alden is an insurance holding company.
The company was not immediately available to provide further details about which states or possible job cuts and charges.
John Alden Chairman Glendon Johnson said in some states, legislative reforms have significantly increased the risk of doing business and made it difficult for the company to compete profitably.
"Pursuing those markets with the best opportunities is critical to our being a focused and profitable managed care company," he said.
John Alden also said it named Lonnie Wright executive vice president and chief operating officer. Wright has been with the company for 26 years, it said.
